scope: a3tal.com Egyptian WordPress post body, first manual pilot sample
method: Human qualitative editorial rubric from publicly rendered source, NOT an official Google rating; word count not directly scored. Only repair actual <=80 with documented deficiencies. Conduct targeted post-publish recheck; check WordPress GSC before altering well performing URLs.

findings: Treats CarPlay as a common possible function without first establishing trim support. MG Egypt's published MG6 spec describes an 8-inch InkaLink unit; validate installed head unit and phone support instead of promising CarPlay.
Troubleshooting is useful but still generic for MG6, with no differentiated infotainment/USB/audio/battery/AC diagnostic scenarios.
Manufacturer-specific source is linked generically, not to the documentary evidence.
Good safety cautions and matrix overview but lacks source-level detail differentiating IntelliLux equipped variants and failures caused by obstructed camera vs actual lamp hardware.
Needs fault isolation for one-sided light, beam distribution, levelling, headlamp water ingress and camera recalibration, plus official owner's manual pointers.
Overlaps general battery and screen advice with insufficient actionable IntelliLux-specific steps.
Strong symptom-to-test tables, pressure-test safety caveats, leak localization, post-service steps and a clearly disclosed independent Astra J diagnosis video.
Word count below 1500 alone does not justify edit.
Separates CVT from hybrid, has useful DTC test matrix, explains Fuel Trim and freeze frame; no high-priority factual defect identified in initial review.
General official source not necessarily year-specific. Monitor during later refresh; do not pad text.
Meaningful differential diagnosis separating intake valve carbon, P0087 fuel rail and P0299 underboost; avoids unsupported periodic carbon-cleaning interval.
More context could be beneficial in the future but not necessary to pass 80%. No change for length alone.
